method: Normal Studio open-document-bytes path after explicit bundled font preparation on the initial blank document, private Vite dependency caches, fresh browser contexts, run 0 warmup then alternating order runs 1-3. Summary is median of per-run medians for edits. Exact text/cursor, page count and deferred completion asserted; no product source/timeout changes.
initialAttempts: Earlier attempts timed out at the 415-page baseline and candidate font preparation stage. Their externalWebFonts=false field was not effective: the Vite process had not received the environment. A later no-CDN cold attempt also stalled on the baseline. A shared Vite dependency cache produced HTTP 504 in another preparation attempt. Final cohort isolates both caches, explicitly prepares local font faces before document timing, and verifies the Vite define and zero external resource requests. These prepared-font results do not establish cold opening latency. Initial attempts are not included in measured samples.
